query_dataset.name: SRR11787767.vcf.gz
query_dataset.description: Illumina NovaSeq WGS of BioSample SAMN14776547 (leading byte range of each mate), production fastp/BWA-MEM2/MarkDuplicates/HaplotypeCaller arguments, single-sample GenotypeGVCFs on the window
query_dataset.comparator: the GCF_016808095.1 reference sequence, assembled from PacBio data of the same BioSample

comparison_unit: VCF record placed by its REF span; genotype cell (record x sample)
strata_note: tag strata overlap and are not additive; members of one partition group are disjoint, cover the universe, and their counts add up to the total less the edge-straddling records

definitions.masked_genotype_cells: missing in the masked stream but not in the unmasked stream, same record and sample
definitions.missing_genotype_cells: a GT with any missing allele in the unmasked stream
definitions.filter_buckets: pass_records: FILTER=PASS; failed_filter_records: a named filter code; unfiltered_records: FILTER='.', meaning no filter was applied
definitions.variant_type_split: '<stratum>:snp' and '<stratum>:indel' count the same region's records by type; their bases are the stratum's bases, so each density is per type
definitions.non_reference_calls: a fully called GT with at least one non-reference allele
definitions.heterozygous_calls: a fully called GT with two different alleles
definitions.homozygous_alt_calls: a fully called GT whose alleles are one and the same non-reference allele

limitations: not truth on either side: a non-reference call marks disagreement between these Illumina reads and the PacBio-derived consensus of the same BioSample, which can come from a consensus error, residual heterozygosity in the sequenced plant, or mis-mapping of the short reads. This is self-consistency against a consensus sequence, not concordance with another callset
reads are the leading records of each FASTQ, not a random sample of the run
raw single-sample calls without the cohort hard filter; SNP and indel records are both counted in variant_records, split in snp_records/indel_records
records straddling a stratum edge are not counted in that stratum
